name: supabase
description: Gives this site a hosted database (Supabase) for sign-ups, forms and app data, set up from chat with no setup steps for the person. Use it whenever someone says they need a database, want to store data, or want sign-ups or form entries saved. Always start with agent_plugin_connect { pluginId: "supabase" }: it shows a sign-in card (the person signs in or signs up at Supabase themselves), turns the connection on, and returns once connected. Then follow the supabase skill: find or create the database, handle Supabase's free limit of two active databases, and speak in plain words only.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Gives your site a database for sign-ups and form entries. You sign in to Supabase and the assistant sets up the rest.

credentialCards.title: Connect Supabase
credentialCards.label: Supabase account
credentialCards.intro: Connect Supabase to set up and work with this site’s database.
usedFor: Sets up databases and applies database changes you approve
credentialCards.keyHint: Review the account and project access requested on the Supabase sign-in page.
credentialCards.permissions: Allows the connected tools to discover your organizations and projects and work with the selected database. Creating, pausing or restoring a project and running database changes require the applicable tool permissions.

credentialCards.title: Connect Supabase with an access token
credentialCards.label: Supabase account
credentialCards.intro: Use this fallback only when browser sign-in cannot start. The token connects the Supabase account, not a site mailer or a project’s public API.
usedFor: Sets up databases and applies database changes you approve
credentialCards.keyHint: Use a Management API personal access token, not an anon or service-role key. Discovery: Organizations, Projects (account-wide), Organization Settings and Project Settings → Read. Database tools: Database, Migrations, API Keys, Advisors and Logs → Read. Add Organization Projects → Read-write only to create a project, Project Settings → Read-write to pause/restore, and Migrations → Read-write to apply migrations. Tool write grants are still required separately.
